about: The Workbench icons of the TuxFootball drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's own icon (tuxfootball.png, GPL 2 or later), made 48x48. TuxFootball-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, TuxFootball.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for upstream's README, AUTHORS and the licences; Folder.info for data and every drawer in it.
